user.title: Welcome to MP Glass
user.description: Name your home. Then open MP Glass in the sidebar to discover your installation.

init.title: MP Glass options
init.description: For 3D plan generation, select direct Gemini and paste your API key. No app to install. Both models are on Google's free tier. Leave the key empty if you only use the dashboard.
